description: Source file implementing the OpenMaxComponent class for managing OpenMAX IL components on Raspberry Pi, including buffer management, port configuration, tunneling, and state transitions.

classes.name: OpenMaxComponent
classes.description: Class managing OpenMAX IL component lifecycle, buffers, ports, and tunneling on Raspberry Pi.

methods.name: SetOutputComponent
methods.description: Sets the output component for tunneling.

methods.name: CloseTunnel
methods.description: Closes the tunnel with downstream components, disables ports, and resets state.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Transitions the component to the idle and then executing state.

methods.name: WriteData
methods.description: Writes data buffers to the component, handling EOS flags.

methods.name: WriteEOS
methods.description: Sends an EOS buffer to the component.

methods.name: GetOutputBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves an available output buffer, enabling port if needed.

methods.name: DropOutputBuffer
methods.description: Drops or re-queues an output buffer.

methods.name: ~OpenMaxComponent
methods.description: Destructor that transitions to idle, flushes, disables ports, and releases buffers.

methods.name: AllocateBuffer
methods.description: Allocates a buffer for a specified port.

methods.name: DisableOutputPort
methods.description: Disables the output port and frees buffers.

methods.name: EnableInputPortAndAllocateBuffers
methods.description: Enables input port and allocates input buffers.

methods.name: EnableOutputPortAndAllocateBuffer
methods.description: Enables output port and allocates output buffers.

methods.name: EnableOutputTunnelling
methods.description: Sets up tunneling to downstream component.

methods.name: OnOutputSettingChanged
methods.description: Marks that output settings have changed, triggering reconfiguration.

methods.name: OnEmptyBufferDone
methods.description: Callback for when an input buffer has been emptied.

methods.name: OnFillBufferDone
methods.description: Callback for when an output buffer has been filled.
